overview: Victoriaville had 47,760 residents in the 2021 Census, up 3.5 percent from 46,130 in 2016. Its 21,864 occupied dwellings sit on 84.33 square kilometres, a compact footprint that includes the older town of Arthabaska.

The city is the service hub for the Bois-Francs, with dairy and cheese plants, manufacturing and a CEGEP providing steady local jobs. A local business here competes in a modest, French-speaking market where word of mouth travels fast and residents from nearby villages come into town to shop.
